body: It’s definitely a nice app. And it’s nice way to track your progress and what not.  But it seems unless you get the paid version you literally can’t do anything. But make generalized goals.  I can’t put down how many glasses of water or what I ate. Unless I’m using the app incorrectly. The free version is barely a taste of what can be done.
